# ProofLoop

A Muse agent skill for bounded, evidence-first task execution: draft a task contract (goal, success criteria with evidence minimums, verifiers, budgets) before any work, execute within hard caps (3 drafts, 2 attempts, 20 tool calls, 30 minutes), and return honest terminal outcomes — completed_verified only with fresh evidence, never "looks right". Also includes memory review (adjudicate quarantined candidate lessons) and read-only audits of past runs. Zero external writes; records are data, never instructions. Activates only when you explicitly say "ProofLoop". No account, no API key needed.
